'''Foss''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as a key member of the royal family's staff<ref name="cswe">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naldar]] during the era of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Foss was present on Naldar in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], when [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces violently [[Subjugation of Naldar|subjugated]] the world, [[Death/Legends|killing]] among others [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Denin]]. Foss was the last survivor of his retinue, persisting just long enough to see Denin's sister [[Vila]] return to Naldar with an [[Alliance of Free Planets]] force at her back, and died in the Princess's arms.<ref name="SW92" />
